note: PLACEHOLDER interest slots. NOT open for enrolment. Parents can only say they are interested; the owner decides which to open. Edit this file and rebuild (python3 lp_build.py && python3 level_pages.py && python3 build_site.py) to add, remove or retime a placeholder. R1-R4 come from docs/schedule/beta_reserved.json; the Monday slots are afternoons/evenings the owner's calendar is free (1:15pm to 9pm). Fields: id (letters, digits, hyphen, max 16; stored with each request, so do not reuse an id for a different time), label, sessions [{day,start,end}], levels (which level cards show it), window (true = a time window, the parent's class would start inside it, with a second weekday to agree), show (false hides it without deleting). T27-* ids are 2027 term-time placeholders (see docs/schedule/term_2027_t1_availability.md): one weekly 90-minute lesson (re-derived 23 Oct 2026 after the 90-minute decision; the old 75-minute T27 ids were replaced), no dates or prices shown, owner to confirm before any opens.
